articles.title: Open Beta is Live!
articles.summary: Kryos open beta v1.0.0 is here. Auto-updating launcher, full OSRS-accurate combat and skilling, Inventory Tags, Task Manager, Perk Hub. Join the Discord for bug reports and feedback.

articles.title: Plugin overhaul: Inventory Tags + Task Manager
articles.summary: Shift+right-click any item to color-tag it (Pick Color / Set Color / Reset Color). New Task Manager side-panel tracks objectives across 5 difficulty tiers — claim perk points as you complete them.

articles.title: Launcher 1.0 released
articles.summary: Auto-updating launcher is now live. No more manual client downloads — just hit Play.
